slots.notes: Three fixed fullscreen background clips (one per hero section), layered behind all content at -z-10, each object-cover, autoPlay loop muted playsInline. Only the active section's video is opacity-100 while the others are opacity-0, crossfading via transition-opacity duration-700 as the user buttons between sections. All foreground type is white, so each clip must be dark/low-contrast enough to keep white text and the cyan accent legible; supply 3 seamless cinematic loops (the spec hardcodes 3 CloudFront mp4s).

Small square brand logo mark reused in three places: the nav top-left (8x8, beside the WE ARE / ORBIT / ENGINEERS wordmark stack), the Section 0 bottom bar (small, rendered at 60% opacity), and as the persistent identity glyph. Single-color glyph that reads on a dark video; needs transparency.

Two thin vertical line/rule graphics pinned absolutely to the left (left-10) and right (right-10) edges, spanning nearly the full viewport height (h-[calc(100%-3rem)] in Section 0, h-[calc(100%-1rem)] in Section 2). Architectural framing accents; line-art with transparency that overlays the video.

Section 1 'Why We Are' column: 4 small (~5w) vertically stacked dot marks, the first filled and the remaining three outline-only, acting as a step/progress indicator beside the label. Tiny single-color glyphs with transparency.

Functional UI glyphs from lucide-react: ChevronDown (used in the bouncing 'Scroll to explore'/'Next' buttons and, rotated, in 'Back to top') and ArrowRight (in the Section 1 'Begin Your Mission' CTA). Library icons rather than bespoke art; a reskin can substitute an equivalent icon set.

Primary typeface for the entire page (display headlines, nav, body, labels) set as font-sans in the Tailwind config. Native value is Google Font 'Inter' (weights 300;400;500;600;700). Headlines lean on the light/normal weights with heavy negative letter-spacing (-3px/-2px), so the substitute should hold up at large sizes with tight tracking.

mechanic: Three fixed fullscreen background videos crossfade (opacity, duration-700) behind a button-driven (not scroll) useState section switcher, while framer-motion AnimatePresence mode='wait' runs cinematic per-section enter/exit transitions (opacity + scale 1.05-1.08 + blur 10-14px, plus y-translation on sections 1 & 2) with custom ease [0.22,1,0.36,1].
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS (Inter set as font-sans via Tailwind config, HSL color tokens in CSS variables) + framer-motion (AnimatePresence/motion) + lucide-react icons; Inter loaded from Google Fonts.
reskinNotes: Colors are authored as raw HSL channel triplets in CSS variables (--background: 210 33% 19%, --foreground: 0 0% 100%, --primary/--accent: 199 89% 60%), so retinting means editing those triplets, not hex tokens. accent and primary are the same cyan and there is no second accent or explicit border color; muted foregrounds are Tailwind opacity utilities (foreground/60, /70, /80) rather than a single token, and surface is just the inverted CTA fill (bg-foreground text-background) since videos cover the viewport. Every string is hardcoded in JSX: the WE ARE / ORBIT / ENGINEERS logo stack, the three nav links, the 51.50732 N / -0.12765 W coordinates, all three section headlines (with manual line breaks), the section number '01', the mission tagline, descriptions, and all CTA/back/next labels. Headlines depend on Inter's metrics with aggressive negative letter-spacing (-3px / -2px) and fixed line breaks plus leading-[0.95]/[1.05] and max-w clamps, so a longer headline or a wider substitute font will rewrap or overflow. The per-section motion variants (scale/blur/y values, 0.8-0.9s durations, ease [0.22,1,0.36,1]) and the section-1/2 staggered delays (0.3-0.55s) are authored inline, not tokenized.
